description: The Cost Allocation Editor lets people split one amount - a purchase requisition, supplier invoice, expense claim, grant or shared contract - across several cost centres, projects, GL accounts or funds. Each line can be entered as a percentage or as an amount; the other value is worked out for you and the pennies always add up to the total.
features: Searchable cost centre list grouped by department, showing the owner and remaining budget
Share (%) and Amount on every line - change either one; rounding differences go to the largest line so the total is exact
Stacked allocation bar, Allocated / remaining summary and a clear status: Fully allocated, % to allocate or Over by %
Split evenly, Fill remaining share, Lock a line, Split templates, Clear and Undo
Budget check per line (warn or block), note required above an amount, minimum % per line, minimum and maximum number of lines
Table layout on wide screens and touch-friendly cards on phones
